newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open slightly lower Monday in line with LME copper after a further build in LME warehouse copper stocks.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to down 0.50 cent from Friday's close of 107.25 cents a lb after trading from 107.40 to 106.40 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a further 2,800 tonnes Monday to 237,750 tonnes, a new 10-month high, while COMEX copper stocks were unchanged at 30,023 short tons.
Copper prices have been struggling to recover from a three-month low set in mid-July after the rise in stocks brought a 12-month rally to an end.

Meanwhile, workers at Falconbridge Ltd's Sudbury mine in Canada began a strike Friday. The mine produced 50,000 tonnes of copper last year, two percent of North American production or 0.6 percent of Western World production.
